CommunityApplications.Profile:
Questly is a self-hosted family points-and-rewards app. Grown-ups award points for quests and good behaviour; kids spend them in a shop of rewards you stock yourself. No third-party accounts, no ads, no subscriptions.
The container is stateless — everything lives in MongoDB, so there is no appdata share to back up and nothing to migrate but the database.
**Support:** raise an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/mahansford/questly/issues).
